metadata.title: About | Names Hub
metadata.description: Learn about Names Hub — an AI-powered bilingual baby name generator built for cross-cultural families.

hero.title: About Names Hub
hero.tagline: An AI-powered bilingual baby name generator built for cross-cultural families.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: We believe naming a child is one of the most meaningful decisions a family makes. Names Hub helps cross-cultural families find names that bridge Chinese and English heritage — names with depth, meaning, and beauty in both languages.

items.deployment: Cloudflare Pages via the OpenNext adapter for low-latency global delivery
items.ai: Generative AI for personalized, meaningful name suggestions

privacy.title: Privacy
